clue.text: Tenderising chopped-up cooking-components

indicators.note: food that is chopped up is cut into pieces and jumbled, so the letters of the first word are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A recipe step: tenderising the meat by chopping it up before it goes in the pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopped-up' looks like more kitchen talk, but it tells you to rearrange the eleven letters of TENDERISING.
explanation.definitionFit: The ingredients of a dish are the separate items a cook combines to make it.

clue.text: There is often room for improvement where one works

definitions.text: There is often room for improvement where one works

parts.words: There is often room for improvement where one works
parts.note: the 'room for improvement' is literally a hospital ward, where patients get better, and the person described works there

explanation.surface: A rueful remark that one's workplace could always be better run.
explanation.definitionFit: A hospital worker who cares for patients spends the shift on a ward, a room where the sick recover.

clue.text: 'e's more ashen-looking, getting up- what a setback!

indicators.note: in a down entry something getting up rises, so these pieces are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: dropped-aitch speech for 'he's', written as the letters E and S
someone more ashen-looking is paler in the face

explanation.surface: A Cockney observer says the patient looks greyer than before: clearly a turn for the worse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting up' turns the whole string ES + PALER, which reads ESPALER, upside down in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: A patient's return to illness after seeming to recover is a setback in their health.

clue.text: Specific point of military assignment

definitions.meaning: a single particular item or fact
a small group of soldiers told off for a particular duty

explanation.definitionFit: A particular item is a fine point of fact, and in the army a squad given a special task is likewise so called.

clue.text: The Mount"—suitable address for a cardinal?

definitions.meaning: a mount is a hill or high ground
a Roman Catholic cardinal is formally addressed as 'Your ...'

explanation.surface: A title for a church dignitary, set beside a lofty place name.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a raised piece of ground, and it is also the honorific title used for cardinals of the Catholic Church.

clue.text: This liquid-carrier has brown luggage-framework that lifts up

parts.note: tan is a light brown colour

indicators.note: in a down entry a piece that lifts up is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a rack is a frame for holding luggage, as on a train or car roof

explanation.surface: Describes some brown-painted vehicle with a raised roof rack for bags.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifts up' turns RACK upside down in this down entry, giving KCAR after TAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway wagon built as a big cylinder carries oil or other fluids in bulk.

clue.text: Drag one's feet on stair-carpet, perhaps

indicators.note: 'perhaps' says the letters might be put together another way, here signalling a rearrangement of the words before it

explanation.surface: Someone dawdling as they plod up the carpeted stairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' asks you to rearrange the thirteen letters of ON plus STAIR-CARPET.
explanation.definitionFit: To dither and put things off is to delay deliberately, figuratively shuffling slowly.

clue.text: Jet-speed is a pest in the garden

parts.note: jet is a deep glossy black
to fly is to move at great speed

explanation.surface: An aircraft's velocity is apparently a nuisance to gardeners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jet-speed' suggests aircraft, but the jet is the black stone and the speed is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: An aphid that infests beans and other garden plants is a common horticultural nuisance.

clue.text: House foundation?

definitions.meaning: a business or institution, as in a fashion house
an institution set up and endowed, or the act of setting something up

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers an organisation such as a firm or hotel and also the act of founding something.

clue.text: Russia's first river in the country

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it follows is taken

parts.note: the Ural is a river flowing from the Ural Mountains to the Caspian Sea

explanation.surface: A geography note about Russia's leading river flowing through the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something situated in the countryside, away from towns, is described with this adjective.

clue.text: Instruments not necessarily out of place in square-dancing

definitions.text: Instruments not necessarily out of place in square-dancing

parts.words: Instruments not necessarily out of place in square-dancing
parts.note: three-sided percussion items would be shapes not out of place among squares, and could be played at a barn dance

explanation.surface: A remark about which instruments suit a square dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Small steel percussion instruments bent into a three-sided shape contrast in geometry with a square.

clue.text: Baseline-place of capital bargains

parts.note: something base is low and cheap
a side is a line of descent, as in on his father's side

explanation.surface: Picture a London market street at the bottom of a long line of shops.
explanation.walkthrough: CHEAPSIDE is a street in the City of London that was a medieval market ('cheap' meaning market); 'capital' here means London.
explanation.definitionFit: This London street was a medieval marketplace where goods were bought and sold.

clue.text: Firms merging with a drink

parts.note: two firms are two companies, each abbreviated CO

explanation.surface: A business merger involving a beverage company.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot chocolate beverage made from powdered cacao beans.

clue.text: Does he shoot his arrows on the air?

definitions.text: Does he shoot his arrows on the air?

parts.words: Does he shoot his arrows on the air?
parts.note: one who shoots arrows into the air, with a nod to the long-running radio soap set in Ambridge that is 'on the air'

explanation.surface: A question about a bowman firing into the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: THE ARCHERS is a long-running BBC radio soap opera about country life, hence 'on the air'.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowman shoots arrows from a bow, and the surname belongs to the family of a famous radio drama.

clue.text: Speaker delivers chapter on Biggles, for example

parts.note: Biggles is the fictional pilot hero of W. E. Johns's boys' adventure books, an example of a flier

explanation.surface: Someone gives a talk on a chapter from a Biggles adventure.
explanation.walkthrough: The Speaker of the House of Commons presides over debates, acting as its presiding officer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Speaker presides over the House of Commons, just as a president of a meeting conducts it.

clue.text: Contemptuous of little French consul, perhaps

indicators.note: 'perhaps' says the letters could be arranged another way, signalling a rearrangement here

parts.note: a little word for French, its abbreviation Fr

explanation.surface: Sneering at some minor diplomat from France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' asks you to mix FR with CONSUL.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing disdain and derision for someone is the same as despising them.

clue.text: Instruction in bars not to overdo it?

definitions.text: Instruction in bars not to overdo it?

parts.words: Instruction in bars not to overdo it?
parts.note: bars are musical measures, and the direction asks the players to keep a moderate pace rather than a drinker's bars

explanation.surface: Advice to pub-goers to drink in moderation.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian tempo marking in a score tells musicians to play at a medium speed.

clue.text: Cheeky manifestation of rent reduction?

parts.note: a rent is a rip or tear
a drop is a fall or reduction

explanation.surface: A cut in a landlord's rent being shown off impudently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheeky' means appearing on the cheek, not impudent.
explanation.definitionFit: A single bead of crying that runs down someone's face shows on the cheek.

clue.text: Good shot holed block at sea

definitions.meaning: a round wooden block with holes, used on sailing ships to tighten the rigging

explanation.definitionFit: The word means an unerring marksman and also a pierced wooden block used in a ship's rigging.

clue.text: Green girl's gemstones

definitions.meaning: belonging to a girl named Beryl, a name that is also a shade of pale green
precious minerals, of which emerald and aquamarine are kinds

explanation.surface: A girl's emerald jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: These silicate minerals include emerald and aquamarine, and the singular is also a girl's name and a sea-green colour.

clue.text: English priest and builder

parts.note: a rector is a parish priest in the Church of England

explanation.surface: An English clergyman who also puts up buildings.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who erects, putting up structures, is a constructor.

clue.text: Wheel-stays, pronounced sue-cess to begin with

parts.note: pronounced means spoke, uttered aloud

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word before is taken

explanation.surface: Advice to sound out 'success' syllable by syllable, oddly next to a bicycle part.
explanation.walkthrough: SPOKE (said) plus the first letter of 'suc-cess'.
explanation.definitionFit: The rods running from a wheel's hub to its rim brace and support it.

clue.text: Operatic heroine not entirely rational

indicators.note: the synonym is not given in full, losing its last letter

parts.note: rational and sane is normal

explanation.surface: An opera's leading lady behaving a little unreasonably.
explanation.walkthrough: Norma is the Druid priestess in Bellini's opera of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: The title role of Bellini's opera is a Druid priestess, a famous soprano part.

clue.text: Passed over for dead, for example?

definitions.text: Passed over for dead, for example?

parts.words: Passed over for dead, for example?
parts.note: saying someone has 'passed over' instead of 'died' is a gentle substitute for a blunt word

explanation.surface: Someone left for dead, overlooked by the rescuers.
explanation.definitionFit: A mild expression used in place of a harsh one, such as passing away for dying.

clue.text: How clumsy, spilling paint!

indicators.note: paint that is spilt splashes about out of shape, so its letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: An exclamation at someone knocking over a tin of paint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spilling' asks you to rearrange the letters of PAINT.
explanation.definitionFit: Unsuitable or awkward actions are inept and ungainly.

clue.text: Symbol to make a business impression

parts.note: trade is commerce or business
a mark is an impression left on a surface

explanation.surface: A firm seeks a logo to stand out in the market.
explanation.definitionFit: A registered emblem identifying a company's goods is its distinctive sign.

clue.text: Painter in metal caravan

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: tin is a metallic element
RA is a Royal Academician, a painter

explanation.surface: An artist living in a metal trailer.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, a Royal Academician, goes inside TIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A caravan is a line of travellers or pack animals moving together, like a procession.

clue.text: March exhibit?

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to take part in a public protest march and also to show how something works.
